verdict.rationale: Lever ships several first-party AI features that generate insights/suggestions from recruiting data — Talent Fit AI-powered candidate matching/scoring, AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries with actionable recaps, and AI-generated interview guides/forms — all vendor-documented. However, evidence is entirely marketing copy with no technical depth on how insights are surfaced, no independent/hands-on validation, and no detail on broader open-ended data analysis beyond these specific features. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration, technical documentation of the AI insight generation, evidence of broader analytics-driven AI suggestions beyond candidate matching and transcripts.
